about.whoWeAreText: Leorodrigues.dev helps companies turn ideas into digital products that are clearer, faster and easier to operate. We work with web, mobile, integrations and system modernization, always focused on experience, maintenance and growth.
about.principlesTitle: Clear communication, solid technology and business focus.
about.principle1Desc: You talk directly with the people building the project, without layers of friction or noise.
about.principle2Desc: We define scope, timeline and priorities in a simple way and keep progress visible throughout delivery.
about.principle3Desc: Every solution is designed to work well today and to keep evolving with less rework in the future.
about.stackTitle: Modern stack designed for quality and maintainability.

modernizationPage.aiDescription: We assess where artificial intelligence can simplify workflows or extend your product. When there is a clear use case, we help plan and integrate the solution with care for data, security, cost and governance—without adopting AI just to follow a trend.

cases.name: STV-ELO
cases.problem: The old system was fragmented, expensive to maintain and hard to use for day-to-day operations.
cases.what: We reorganized the experience, refactored the product core and modernized the presentation and business layers.
cases.result: The solution became more reliable, easier to evolve and ready for operational growth.

cases.name: Plural
cases.problem: A system built for mobile had been hastily adapted to the web, serving neither channel well nor the company’s different services.
cases.what: We built a new ecosystem, with a dedicated project for each service instead of forcing a single solution for everything.
cases.result: The operation gained a clearer, scalable platform better prepared for new services and teams.

t0.name: Adriano Machado
t0.content: Léo is an exceptional professional. He delivered ahead of schedule and exceeded expectations. He put our company on Brazil's tech map.

t1.name: Vivian Oliveira
t1.content: Working with Léo has been amazing! Proactive, efficient, great communicator—he solves problems fast. Committed to results and people, always ready to help, listen and support. Always learning to grow even further.

t2.name: Bianca Cabral
t2.content: If I had one word for working with Leonardo, it would be partnership. He has a sharp eye for product and business, takes design work seriously, respects feedback maturely and includes my input. Clear communication, aligned ideas and real collaboration—plus strong technical skills and a light, productive, outcome-focused environment.
